example_en: Burning flames consumed the entire forest.

definition: a filthy or soiling substance (as mud, dust or grime); dirt.
example: ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿದ ಕಾಲುಷ್ಯ ಅದನ್ನು ಕುಡಿಯಲು ಅಯೋಗ್ಯವಾಗಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The dirt mixed in the water made it unfit for drinking.

definition: a portion or division of a whole that is separate or distinct; a part.
example_en: This part must be read and finished first.

definition: a kind of bread that is soft, bulging, and usu. leavened.
example_en: Mother made hot, soft leavened bread in the morning.

definition: a deep fissure in the earth.
example: ಭೂಕಂಪದಿಂದ ನೆಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಆಳವಾದ ಕುೞಿವಳ್ಳ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A deep fissure formed in the ground due to the earthquake.

definition: without equal; peerless; matchless.
example: ಆ ಚಿತ್ರಗಾರನ ಕಲೆ ನಿಸ್ಸಮವಾದುದು ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೊಗಳಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone praised that painter's art as peerless.

definition: reverential salutation; respectful obeisance.
example_en: The disciple offered a reverential salutation to his teacher.

definition: the cotton plant Gossypium indicum (= G. neglectum) of Malvaceae family; wild cotton plant.
example_en: The farmer grew wild cotton in his field.

definition: thick; fat; corpulent; plump.
example_en: That child has grown up plump.

definition: the act and art of using an evil, supernatural power over people and their affairs; sorcery; witch-craft.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಟಗಾರಿಕೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಜನರಿಗೆ ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: People in that village believe in witchcraft.

definition: to cause to become bend something that is flexible.
example_en: She pulled the creeper so as to bend it.

definition: (diseases as blister) to infect plants.
example_en: The disease came and infected the plants with blisters.

definition: refreshing sleep.
example: ಪ್ರಯಾಣದ ಆಯಾಸದ ನಂತರ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸಿಹಿನಿದ್ದೆ ಬಂತು.
example_en: After the fatigue of travel, he got refreshing sleep.

definition: an impractical saying.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತು ಕೇವಲ ಹೋಮಾತು ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ನಕ್ಕರು.
example_en: Everyone laughed saying his words were just an impractical saying.

definition: (one's arrogance) to be reduced.
example_en: His arrogance was reduced.

definition: a word, statement not in agreement with the circumstance.
example: ಅವನು ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡ್ಡಮಾತು ಆಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಕೆರಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He spoke a contradictory statement in the meeting and angered everyone.

definition: (cricket) a shot by a batsman glancing off the ball with deflected impact; a glancing.
example: ಬ್ಯಾಟ್ಸ್‌ಮನ್ ಚೆಂಡನ್ನು ಜಾರೇಟು ಹೊಡೆದು ಒಂದು ರನ್ ತೆಗೆದನು.
example_en: The batsman glanced the ball and took a single run.

definition: the fact of being expelled from one's own country and living elsewhere permanently or for a prolonged time.
example_en: Due to political reasons, exile from his country befell him.

definition: to slap the palms.
example_en: He danced happily, slapping his palms.

definition: the act of planting, establishing, etc.
example_en: The establishing of a new school began in the village.

definition: a kind of good quality cloth.
example_en: She had worn a good-quality cloth sari.

definition: to offer or expose to view; to show; to exhibit.
example_en: She exhibited her art to everyone.

definition: the act of shaking or being shaken violently; agitation.
example_en: The violent shaking of the trees occurred due to the storm.

definition: to do physical harm or damage to; to hurt; to injure.
example_en: That wicked man injured the innocent animal.

definition: to push the faeces out from the bowels; to pass the stools; to excrete.
example: ಔಷಧಿ ಸೇವಿಸಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಉಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: After taking the medicine, he was able to pass stools easily.

definition: (in pl.) organised numerical facts; statistics.
example_en: The government published the statistics.

definition: the act of perturbing, troubling or making (something) turbid.
example_en: Because of his troubling, the lake water became muddy.

definition: a man who takes part in or carries out a secret plot, as conspiracy; a conspirator.
example_en: The conspirator devised the plot in a secret meeting.

definition: a heavy, thrusting blow with the fist; a punch.
example_en: He received a heavy punch during the scuffle.

definition: to putforth a doctrine and a reason or reasons to prove it; to argue.
example_en: Two scholars argued their views in the assembly.

definition: full of colour; of vivid colours; colourful.
example_en: The festival bazaar was full of colourful clothes.

definition: indebtedness for a trivial thing or favour.
example_en: One should not hold indebtedness even for a small favour like an areca nut.

definition: the total or two or more numbers; the sum; an aggregate.
example_en: He asked what the total sum of the account came to.

definition: a mouth that is watering.
example: ರುಚಿಯಾದ ಅಡುಗೆ ನೋಡಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಒಱೆವಾಯ್ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing the tasty food, his mouth watered.

definition: a container, case or receptacle, usu. rectangular, of wood, metal, etc., and often with a hinged lid or removable cover; a box.
example_en: The children arranged the toys inside the box.

definition: count - the act of counting; the number reached by counting; a reckoning of the total.
example_en: The counting of the voters is not yet finished.

definition: a kind of cannon that is fired from behind, to shoot the heavy projectiles from.
example_en: The cannon fired from behind was used from the rear of the fort.

definition: extending without interruption or break; continuous; not broken.
example_en: That range of hills extended continuously without a break.

definition: to come to one's hand.
example: ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಂಬಳ ಅವನ ಕೈಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: After the work was finished, the salary came to his hand.

definition: extreme dislike or distaste; aversion; antipathy; repugnance.
example: ಆ ಆಹಾರದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸೀವರ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: He had an aversion towards that food.

definition: a mountainous region.
example_en: This is a village of the mountainous region, the cold is intense.

definition: strong restriction, restraint or objection.
example_en: The government imposed a strong restriction on that project.

definition: the hollow under the arm at the shoulder; the armpit; axilla.
example: ಹಳಗನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೌಂಕುಳ್ ಎಂದರೆ ಕಂಕುಳು ಎಂದೇ ಅರ್ಥ.
example_en: In old Kannada, 'kauṅkuḷ' simply means the armpit.

definition: a coercive behaviour or oppressive way of talking.
example: ಆ ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಜನರ ಮೇಲೆ ರೋಫ್ ತೋರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That policeman showed a coercive, oppressive attitude towards ordinary people.

definition: to produce light, sharp, continuous chirping sounds, as birds.
example_en: The birds were sitting on the tree chirping continuously.

definition: a man worthy of respect; a venerable man.
example_en: The villagers all respected that venerable man.

definition: a cockroach or any other insect that eats up clothes.
example_en: The cockroach ate up the clothes kept in the cupboard.

definition: a round plate made by weaving thin strips of bamboo for developing cocoons.
example: ರೇಷ್ಮೆ ಹುಳುಗಳಿಗೆ ಚಂದ್ರಂಕಿ ಹಾಸಿ ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಕುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They spread round bamboo trays for the silkworms and rear them.

definition: transporting over or across; carrying on to the other side (of a river, sea etc.) 2) helping to cross over or to coming out of danger, difficult situation or spiritual ignorance.
example: ಆ ದೋಣಿ ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಕರನ್ನು ನದಿಯ ಆಚೆಗೆ ಸಾಗಿಸುವ ಉತ್ತಾರಕ ಸಾಧನ.
example_en: That boat is an uttāraka device that carries passengers to the other side of the river.

definition: the state of being crooked, curved.
example: ಆ ಕೋಲಿನ ಮುಡುಕು ಕೈಗೆ ಹಿಡಿಯಲು ಅನುಕೂಲವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The curved bend of that stick was convenient to hold in hand.

definition: to become erect; to stand straight.
example_en: The sprout of the plant stood erect from the ground.

definition: preceded by five others in a series; sixth.
example_en: Today is the sixth class examination.

definition: sexual intercourse; copulation.
example_en: In the zoology lesson, they explained about mating.

definition: to roll oneself and lie on one's belly.
example_en: He rolled himself and lay face down on the grass.

definition: a kind of garment.
example_en: She wore a new siratāḷi garment for the festival.

definition: that which is dry, withered, faded.
example: ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯ ಬಿಸಿಲಿಗೆ ಗಿಡದ ಎಲೆಗಳೆಲ್ಲ ತಾಱು ಆದವು.
example_en: In the summer heat all the plant's leaves became withered and dry.

definition: a bird, akin to crow, resembling the pheasant; a crow-pheasant.
example_en: The crow-pheasant built its nest in the tree.

definition: a small fixed wheel, sometimes turning in a block, with a grooved rim in which a rope or chain runs, as to raise a weight attached at one end by pulling on the other end; a pulley.
example_en: They used a pulley to draw water from the well.

definition: a serious wound.
example_en: The soldier suffered a serious wound in the battle.

definition: to know, understand the custom of.
example: ಹೊಸಬನಿಗೆ ಈ ಊರಿನ ನಡೆಗಾಣಲು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸಮಯ ಬೇಕಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The newcomer needed some time to understand the customs of this town.

definition: a man who has trust, confidence or belief in (something).
example_en: He was a man who had trust in God.

definition: (the skin) to become thick and hardened; to become callous.
example_en: The labourer's fingers had become thick and hardened.

definition: a small, flat, round or square ornamental piece of metal (as of gold) hung by a string (as in a necklace) worn round the neck.
example_en: There was a gold pendant on her neck.

definition: want of unity; a breaking up of union or concord; disunion; disintegration.
example_en: The disunity within the party caused the defeat in the election.

definition: to massage the body with oil, unguents and to bathe.
example: ಪ್ರತಿ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಎಣ್ಣೆ ಹಚ್ಚಿ ಅಭ್ಯಂಗಿಸುವುದು ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು.
example_en: Massaging the body with oil every morning is good for health.

definition: the work or profession of making salt.
example_en: Many people in that town are engaged in salt-making.

definition: regulated vibration of the voice (while singing).
example_en: There was a beautiful vibration in the singer's voice.

definition: a cow-shed.
example_en: They tied the cows in the cow-shed in the evening.

definition: a main road of a city.
example_en: On the fair day, the main road of the city was full of people.

definition: (dial.) an acute infectious disease, usu. affecting children, caused by a bacillus (Bordetella pertussis) and characterised by a mucous discharge from the nose and later by repeated attacks of coughing that end in a forced intake of breath or whoop; a whooping cough.
example_en: The child had whooping cough and coughed all night.

definition: a flat nose.
example: ಅವನ ನಡ್ಡಿಮೂಗು ಅವನ ಮುಖಕ್ಕೆ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ರೂಪ ನೀಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: His flat nose gave his face a distinctive look.

definition: a constellation consisting of Canes Venatici, Arcturus, Spica etc.
example_en: The astrologers pointed out the Kanyavajra constellation in the sky.

definition: the height of a normal person.
example_en: The height of that wall was about the height of a normal person.

definition: any of various families of lepidopteran insects active in the daytime, having a sucking mouthpart, slender body, ropelike, knobbed antennae, and four broad, usu. brightly coloured, membranous wings; a butter-fly.
example: ಹಾತೆ ಹೂವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ರೆಕ್ಕೆ ಬಡಿಯಿತು.
example_en: The butterfly sat on the flower and flapped its wings.

definition: hair that is jet-black.
example_en: The poet sang about her jet-black hair.

definition: an outlet for the excess water in a water tank, reservoir, etc. to flow out.
example_en: The excess water flowed out through the tank's outlet.

definition: to make into a bundle; to wrap or tie together; to bundle.
example_en: The old poem has a description of bundling clothes together.

definition: a small sword or a dagger.
example: ಯೋಧನು ಕೈವಾಳನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿ ಶತ್ರುವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಎರಗಿದನು.
example_en: The warrior raised his dagger and rushed at the enemy.

definition: something that is presented; a presentation; a gift.
example_en: She gave me a sari as a gift.

definition: a blind person.
example_en: The blind person cannot see the path.

definition: the inner layer of cells of the embryo, from which is formed the lining of the digestive tract, of other internal organs, and of certain glands.
example: ಭ್ರೂಣದ ಒಳ ಆಸ್ತರಣ ಅಂಗಗಳ ರಚನೆಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The inner lining layer of the embryo gives rise to the organs.

definition: extra or additional quantity of grains or corns given or to be given at regular intervals, to person for the use of grains or corns taken on loan.
example_en: While repaying the loan, the extra grain had to be given too.

definition: a type of intense, periodically returning headache, usually limited to one side of the head and often accompanied by nausea, visual disorders, etc.; migraine.
example: ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಆಗಾಗ್ಗೆ ಒತ್ತಲೆ ಶೂಲೆ ಬಂದು ಕಾಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: She was often troubled by recurring migraine headaches.

definition: a man who has specialised in administrating medicine to a patient for causing loss of sensation by an anesthetic in a specific area or for the loss of consciousness.
example: ಅರಿವಳಿಕೆತಜ್ಞನು ಶಸ್ತ್ರಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ರೋಗಿಗೆ ಅರಿವಳಿಕೆ ನೀಡಿದನು.
example_en: The anesthetist administered anesthesia to the patient before the surgery.

definition: an official order, edict or decision of a court of law; a decree.
example_en: The court issued a decree in that case.

definition: (dupl.) day and day; days.
example_en: Even working day after day, the poor man's poverty did not lessen.

definition: to deceive with buttery words or flattery.
example: ಅವನು ಸಿಹಿಮಾತಿನಿಂದ ಜನರನ್ನು ಬೆಲ್ಲಿಸಿ ಮೋಸ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He deceived people with sweet words and cheated them.

definition: stirred up; agitated; shaken up.
example_en: The lake's water became stirred up and agitated by the wind.

definition: a crossing over; a passing over from one side to its opposite one.
example_en: Crossing over the border is unlawful.

definition: a beloved man.
example_en: That beloved man won everyone's heart.

definition: to go or come in; to enter.
example_en: He entered into the hut.

definition: the act or fact of suggesting the outline or sketch of something.
example_en: An outline suggestion of the plan was given at the meeting.

definition: to pour water.
example_en: He pours water on the plants every day.

definition: the act or an instance of dismissing from consideration.
example_en: The committee dismissed that proposal.

definition: the outside top covering of a building; the roof; terrace.
example_en: Before the rainy season they repaired the roof of the house.

definition: a camphor crystal.
example_en: The priest offered the camphor crystal to the deity.

definition: essential; absolutely necessary; indispensable; essential.
example_en: This medicine is essential for the patient.

definition: a thin, thread-like wire of gold.
example_en: The thin gold wire was shining in the ornament.

definition: fit to be invaded.
example_en: That fort was easily fit to be invaded.

definition: the profession of a medical doctor.
example_en: He took up the profession of a medical doctor.

definition: a frame for hanging clothes.
example_en: They used the clothes-frame to dry the wet clothes.

definition: to be seized by; to be overtaken; to be subjected to.
example_en: He was seized by fever.

definition: the act of throwing; a casting; a hurling.
example_en: His throw of the ball was very fast.

definition: that which charms or is charming.
example: ಆ ಚಿತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸರೋಚಕ ಗುಣ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In that painting, a charming quality stood out visibly.

definition: the act or an instance of trembling, shivering.
example_en: His hands showed trembling out of fear.

definition: holy water, esp. the water used in the service of a deity.
example_en: The priest gave holy water to the devotees.

definition: a fixed aim, objective, purpose.
example_en: He had a clear aim in life.

definition: a kind of stringed musical instrument.
example_en: In ancient times the stringed instrument was popular.

definition: to become radiant, luminous.
example_en: With sunrise, the sky became radiant.

definition: the fact of being away (from the beloved person).
example_en: The separation from her beloved caused her great pain.

definition: the wailing sound.
example_en: At night a wailing sound was heard from the forest.

definition: a hall or building where governmental deliberations are officially held; a court.
example_en: The village disputes used to be resolved at the court hall.

definition: the mountain-king; any of the seven mythological mountains.
example_en: The peak of the mountain-king touched the clouds.

definition: a spherical sweetmeat made of bengal gram flour, sugar, ghee, etc.
example_en: On the festival day, mother made laddus.

definition: the moon light.
example_en: Moonlight had spread over the silver hill.

definition: emanating from or caused by, experience.
example_en: His wisdom is one that is caused by experience.

definition: (rural or rustic language) little - a) small in size; b) small in amount, number or degree; not much; c) short in duration or distance; not long; d) small in force, intensity, etc.
example_en: Only a little rice remained in the vessel.

definition: to tie a belt or band round one's waist.
example_en: Tying a belt around his waist, he set out for work.

definition: the sugar cane.
example_en: The farmer watered the sugar cane field.

definition: anger; wrath.
example_en: His words caused anger in the teacher.

definition: the place, as village, town, country, etc. of one's birth.
example_en: She never forgot her place of birth.

definition: a hurrying; hurry.
example_en: She hurriedly finished the cooking.

definition: a defective pearl.
example_en: A defective pearl had gotten mixed into that necklace.

definition: a tax payer.
example: ಅಚ್ಚುವಳಿಗ ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The taxpayer pays his tax properly every year.

definition: the yolk of an egg; vitellus.
example_en: The yolk of the egg was yellow in colour.

definition: of limited size; of comparatively restricted dimensions; not big; little; small.
example_en: This is a small house, but it is nice.

definition: execution of an order; the act or process of carrying out what one is ordered.
example_en: The soldiers carried out the execution of the order faithfully.

definition: dry cow-dung.
example_en: Dry cow-dung is used to light the stove.

definition: a rascal; a scoundrel.
example: ಆ ಅನಕ ಊರಿನ ಜನರನ್ನು ಮೋಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That rascal was cheating the people of the town.

definition: to attack; to fall upon.
example_en: The enemies attacked the village at dawn.

definition: a greatly frightened man.
example_en: That greatly frightened man hid in the corner.

definition: a loop with a knot that slips along the rope or line around which it is made; a slipknot-loop.
example_en: He put a slipknot-loop around the bullock's neck.

definition: (gen. pronounced with the vowel 'a') the twenty-eighth letter of Kannaḍa alphabet and the fourteenth consonant.
example_en: The child has learned to write the letter dha.

definition: adjacent; neighbouring.
example: ಸಾಮಂತ ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳು ಪ್ರಬಲ ರಾಜ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಕಪ್ಪ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: The neighbouring kingdoms used to pay tribute to the powerful kingdom.

definition: greatly enjoyed; delighted.
example_en: On hearing the result, she was delighted.

definition: two times; twice.
example_en: She wrote the letter twice.

definition: sand, clay, etc. gradually deposited by moving water, as along a river bed or the shore of a lake; alluvium; alluvial soil.
example: ನದಿಯ ದಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೆಕ್ಕಲು ಮಣ್ಣು ಸಮೃದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ಸಂಗ್ರಹವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: Alluvial soil has accumulated richly on the riverbank.

definition: young age.
example_en: The boys of young age were absorbed in play.

definition: a servant who gets provisions as compensation for his labour.
example: ಪಡಿಯಾಳು ದಿನವಿಡೀ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿ ಸಂಜೆ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಪಡೆದುಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: The servant worked all day and received rice in the evening as his wages.

definition: the upper part of the body in humans, joined to the trunk by the neck, containing the brain, eyes, ears, nose, and mouth; the head.
example_en: In the accident, his head got injured.

definition: to look upon or treat with contempt; to despise; to scorn; to disdain.
example_en: It is not a good quality to despise the poor.

definition: (econ.) the principle of substitution.
example_en: The economists explained the principle of substitution.

definition: to keep away.
example_en: They kept the children away from the danger.

definition: a man who watches the stars.
example: ಆ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರವೀಕ್ಷಕ ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರಾಗಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That scientist was renowned as a famous star-watcher.

definition: to send a message through a messenger.
example_en: He sent the message through a messenger.

definition: a servant of a servant.
example: ಆ ಅನುದಾಸ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಸೇವಕನ ಆಜ್ಞೆಯನ್ನು ಪಾಲಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That servant of a servant obeyed the chief servant's orders.

definition: to make a loud vocal sound or utterance; to cry.
example_en: He cried out loudly in pain.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: A nadacheelaita tree had grown on the hill.

definition: to shoot (an arrow).
example_en: The archer shot an arrow toward the target.

definition: giving way easily under pressure, as a feather pillow or moist clay.
example_en: That pillow was very soft, giving way easily under pressure.

definition: a kind of herbal plant.
example_en: The leaves of the kirugaḍasige plant are used for medicine.

definition: a kind of folk dance played by a number of persons holding long threads, each one twining and untwining with others repeatedly, and striking the sticks rhythmically to the songs sung.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಡುಗಿಯರು ಜಡೆಮುಡಿ ಆಡುತ್ತಾ ಕೋಲು ಬಡಿದರು.
example_en: At the festival, the girls played the jademudi dance, striking sticks as they twined and untwined.

definition: (pl.) the eight regents of eight directions.
example_en: In mythology, the eight regents of directions protect the eight directions.

definition: to form a line; to be set in a tidy manner.
example_en: The children stood in a line in front of the school.

definition: he who has the habit of accusing others.
example: ಆ ಪರಿವಾದಶೀಲ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಯಾರನ್ನೂ ಬಿಡದೆ ಆಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That fault-finding person spares no one from his accusations.

definition: an offspring of a donkey and a horse; a mule.
example_en: He bought a mule from the market.

definition: a very high speed.
example_en: That train moved at a very high speed.

definition: the quality of being very sharp or keen or the fact of having a very sharp edge or point.
example: ಆ ಕತ್ತಿಯ ಕಡುಗೂರ್ಪು ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: Seeing the great sharpness of that sword, everyone was startled.

definition: the border, area adjoining, a dam.
example_en: Greenery had grown in the area adjoining the dam.

definition: the movable lid of skin that serves to cover and uncover the front of the eyeball; the eyelid.
example_en: Heavy with sleep, his eyelid closed.

definition: a female nymph of the heaven.
example: ಅಚ್ಚರೆ ಆಕಾಶದಿಂದ ಇಳಿದು ಸರೋವರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ನಾನ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: The heavenly nymph descended from the sky and bathed in the lake.

definition: the morning sun.
example_en: The morning sun rose from behind the hill.

definition: a vertical fold of cloth (as of a sīre, dhōti, etc.).
example_en: The pleats of her sari fluttered in the wind.

definition: a kind of sweet pudding, made using butter.
example_en: Mother made butter pudding for the festival.

definition: a barber's wife.
example_en: The barber's wife was cooking at home.

definition: to follow, come in, form a line.
example_en: The passengers were standing in a line for the ticket.

definition: the quality of being very large; largeness; hugeness; gigantism.
example_en: The vastness of this ground amazed everyone.

definition: anything produced in the course of making another thing; a secondary or incidental product or result; a by-product.
example_en: Tar is a by-product in petrol production.

definition: not deep; shallow.
example_en: This pond is shallow, even children can play in it.

definition: a hollow in the stem or a branch of a tree.
example_en: An owl lived in the hollow of the tree.

definition: a game played with an inflated leather ball by two teams on a field with goals at each end, the object being to get the ball across the opponentś goal, advancing the ball by kicking with the foot; foot-ball.
example_en: The children were playing football on the field in the evening.
